source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Esophageal irritation, since bisphosphonates can cause esophagitis if the medication contacts the esophageal lining for a prolonged period","B":"A noticeable rise in blood pressure specifically tied to standing upright shortly after taking the dose each morning","C":"A brief episode of lightheadedness that some clients notice shortly after taking the dose in the morning","D":"Improved absorption alone, with fairly little connection to preventing any kind of local esophageal tissue irritation"}}
source_row.rationale: Remaining upright after oral bisphosphonate administration helps prevent esophageal irritation and esophagitis, since the medication can cause significant esophageal damage if it remains in contact with the esophageal lining for a prolonged period, such as when lying down shortly after dosing.
source_row.stem: A nurse teaches a client taking oral alendronate for osteoporosis to remain upright and avoid lying down for at least 30 minutes after taking the medication. This instruction helps prevent:
